target.html:
Signature

Midnight Sour

Whiskey · Lemon · Lavender

Ingredients

  • 60ml Bourbon Whiskey
  • 25ml Fresh Lemon Juice
  • 20ml Lavender Syrup
  • 15ml Egg White
  • 2 dashes Aromatic Bitters

Method

1Dry shake all ingredients
2Add ice, shake hard
3Double strain into glass
Glass Coupe
ABV 18%
Serve Up
